newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 2-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 2-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add reserves to the banking system Tuesday through a round of two-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
With two more days left in the maintenance period, the Fed faces around a $4 billion average daily add need, which can be taken care of through large daily operations, most agreed.
Federal funds were a touch firm at 5-5/16 percent.
Monday, the Fed added via overnight system RPs.
